description: This file defines an enumeration 'SmsCampaignTriggerType' representing different trigger types for SMS campaigns, including methods to convert integers to enum instances and to obtain descriptive data objects for each type.

classes.name: SmsCampaignTriggerType
classes.description: An enum representing possible trigger types for SMS campaigns, with associated codes and integer values, as well as utility methods for conversions.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Converts an integer to the corresponding SmsCampaignTriggerType enum, returning INVALID if the input is null or does not match.

methods.name: triggerType (Integer triggerTypeId)
methods.description: Returns an EnumOptionData object for the given trigger type ID, using fromInt to interpret the integer.

methods.name: triggerType (SmsCampaignTriggerType triggerType)
methods.description: Returns an EnumOptionData object representing the given trigger type enum, with descriptive label.
